items.exampleEn: Most of the flavor in this candy is created synthetically.
items.exampleZh: 這種糖果的味道大多是人工合成的。

items.exampleEn: The older lion behaved dominantly toward the younger males.
items.exampleZh: 那頭年長的獅子對年輕的公獅表現出支配的姿態。

items.exampleEn: The dish was exotically spiced with ginger and lemon grass.
items.exampleZh: 這道菜用薑和香茅調味，充滿異國風味。

items.exampleEn: She explained her absence believably, so nobody asked any more questions.
items.exampleZh: 她把缺席的原因解釋得合情合理，所以沒人再追問。

items.exampleEn: By today's standards, the first computers were primitively designed.
items.exampleZh: 以今天的標準來看，最早的電腦設計得很原始簡陋。

items.exampleEn: She smiled frostily and said nothing.
items.exampleZh: 她冷冷地笑了一下，什麼也沒說。

items.exampleEn: She wore an aqua dress to the summer party.
items.exampleZh: 她穿了一件水藍色的洋裝去參加夏日派對。

items.sentenceEn: In meetings, my boss often acts dominantly and rarely lets others speak.
items.sentenceZh: 開會時，我老闆常常很強勢，很少讓別人說話。

items.audioEn: When I asked about the delay, the receptionist answered frostily and turned back to her computer.
items.audioZh: 我問起延誤的事，櫃台人員冷冷地回了一句，就轉回去看她的電腦。
items.questionZh: 櫃台人員如何回應說話者？
options: In a cold way, with little interest in helping

items.sentenceEn: The water in the bay was a clear, bright aqua.
items.sentenceZh: 海灣裡的水是清澈明亮的水藍色。

items.sentenceEn: Rubber can now be made synthetically instead of from trees.
items.sentenceZh: 現在橡膠可以用人工合成，不必再取自樹木。

items.stemEn: Even the youngest actor delivered her lines ____, and the audience truly felt her fear.
items.stemZh: 連最年輕的演員都把台詞說得令人信服，觀眾真切感受到她的恐懼。

items.stemEn: My manager greeted me ____ after I arrived an hour late.
items.stemZh: 我遲到一小時，經理冷冷地跟我打了招呼。

items.passageEn: The designers of the new play at the city theater faced a difficult task: the story takes place on a tropical island, but the budget was small. They used synthetically made palm leaves that look real from a distance, and they painted the back wall a bright aqua to suggest the sea. The costumes are exotically colorful, though the main character's simple clothes are primitively sewn on purpose. The lead actor, a versatile performer who usually plays cruel characters, plays a kind fisherman surprisingly believably. Critics were mostly positive, although one critic wrote frostily that the island "looked more like a hotel lobby."
items.passageZh: 市立劇院新戲的設計團隊面臨一個難題：故事發生在熱帶島嶼上，但預算很少。他們用人工合成的棕櫚葉，遠看就像真的；又把背景牆漆成明亮的水藍色來代表大海。戲服色彩繽紛、充滿異國情調，不過主角的簡單衣服是刻意縫得很粗糙原始的。男主角是位戲路很廣、通常演壞人的演員，這次演一位善良的漁夫，卻出奇地令人信服。評論大多正面，不過有一位評論家冷冷地寫道，那座島「看起來比較像飯店大廳」。

questions.questionZh: 舞台背景牆漆成什麼顏色？為什麼？
options: 深藍色，讓觀眾以為是夜晚的天空

questions.questionZh: 那位評論家冷冷地批評了什麼？
options: 島嶼看起來比較像飯店大廳

items.promptZh: 我想把浴室的牆漆成水藍色。
referenceEn: I want to paint the bathroom walls aqua.
I'd like to paint the walls of my bathroom aqua.
rubricZh: 「漆成水藍色」用 aqua，例如 paint the walls aqua、paint the walls an aqua color 等
「想要」可寫，例如 want to、would like to 等
「浴室的牆」可寫，例如 the bathroom walls、the walls of my bathroom 等

items.promptZh: 對我們來說，這首曲子聽起來充滿異國風情，非常美。
referenceEn: To us, this piece of music sounded exotically beautiful.
This tune sounded exotically beautiful to us.
rubricZh: 「充滿異國風情」用 exotically 修飾形容詞（例如 exotically beautiful 等）
「曲子」可寫，例如 piece of music、tune、song 等
時態配合內容（例如 sounded、sounds 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確
